tasks.prompt: Implement src/retry.mjs exporting async retry(operation, options = {}). Options: attempts defaults to 3 and must be a positive integer; baseDelayMs defaults to 0 and must be finite and nonnegative. Validate both before invoking operation. sleep defaults to an async no-op, shouldRetry defaults to a predicate returning true. Pass a one-based attempt number to operation. Resolve immediately on success. On rejection, preserve the exact error identity; consult shouldRetry(error, attempt) only when another attempt remains. A false predicate stops retries. Between retryable failures call await sleep(baseDelayMs * 2 ** (attempt - 1)); never sleep after success or the final failure. An optional AbortSignal must be checked before each operation and after sleep; reject with signal.reason when present, otherwise an Error named AbortError. No operation runs when already aborted. Predicate and sleep errors propagate unchanged. Preserve the export and existing tests.

Implement src/json-lines.mjs exporting async generator parseJsonLines(chunks). Accept sync or async iterables of strings or Uint8Array chunks. Parse newline-delimited JSON across arbitrary chunk boundaries, including UTF-8 multibyte characters split across byte chunks. Both LF and CRLF are line separators. Ignore blank or whitespace-only physical lines. Parse a final nonempty line without a trailing newline. Strip one optional initial UTF-8 BOM, only at the beginning of the entire stream. Yield decoded JSON values in order. Malformed JSON must throw SyntaxError with a numeric lineNumber property giving the one-based physical line, counting blank lines too. Preserve upstream iterator error identity. Use incremental processing, preserving the export and existing tests.

Fix subset() incorrectly rejecting contained prerelease ranges. For example, ^10.2.0-beta.2 should be a subset of ^10.2.0-beta.1. Preserve normal prerelease exclusion, inclusive/exclusive bound semantics, empty ranges, and existing options. Investigate both lower and upper bounds rather than special-casing this example. The upstream repository and its original layout are under src/. Preserve existing tests. Public checks are adapted Node tests, not the complete upstream TAP suite.

Fix range parsing with long build metadata. Build metadata must not change range meaning or bleed into version numbers. A loose range consisting of 4.17.0+ followed by 250 letters a and then 3 must mean exactly 4.17.0. The problem also affects comparator whitespace, partial versions, hyphen ranges, tilde/caret ranges and OR sets. Preserve prereleases and existing strict/loose behavior. The upstream repository and its original layout are under src/. Preserve existing tests. Public checks are adapted Node tests, not the complete upstream TAP suite.
